system.description:
You take a chakra seal and imprint your chakra onto it, before attempting to bind it to a creature, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target creature is branded with a flaming chakra seal for the duration. While branded with this seal, creatures have extreme difficulty molding chakra. When the affected creature would cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component, They must make a Chakra Control check at disadvantage vs your Ninjutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 5d8 Fire damage. Creatures can make a Ninshou skill check as an action vs your Ninjutsu save DC to break the seal ending this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, its duration becomes 1 Hour. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, its casting time becomes 10 minutes and its duration becomes 1 Week. Affected creatures lose the ability to mold chakra for the duration. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, and its duration becomes Until Dispelled. Affected creatures lose the ability to mold chakra for the duration.
